lead.zh: 负责把 AI 服务跑起来并稳住的人：性能从哪来、成本从哪来、出事时先看哪里。
lead.en: For people who keep AI services running: where performance comes from, where cost comes from, and what to check first when things break.

zh: 说出首字延迟和吞吐各自受什么影响，各给一个优化手段
给线上服务列出三件必须监控的事，并说明各自先查什么
供应商宣布模型退役时，能走一遍迁移评估的四个检查项
en: Say what drives time-to-first-token and throughput respectively, with one optimization for each
List three things a live service must monitor, and what to check first for each
When a vendor announces retirement, walk through the four migration-assessment checks
